description: This file defines the AzureTableTransactionalStateStorageFactory class, which implements the creation and lifecycle management of transactional state storage for Orleans grains using Azure Table Storage. It includes methods for creating storage instances, making partition keys, initializing Azure tables, and integrating with the silo lifecycle.

classes.name: AzureTableTransactionalStateStorageFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing Azure Table Storage based transactional state storage for Orleans grains, supporting lifecycle participation and table initialization.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to create an instance of AzureTableTransactionalStateStorageFactory using dependency injection and options monitoring.

methods.name: AzureTableTransactionalStateStorageFactory
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with required dependencies, options, and settings.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new transactional state storage instance for a specific grain state.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the factory to the silo lifecycle to initialize resources at the appropriate stage.

methods.name: MakePartitionKey
methods.description: Generates a sanitized partition key for storing grain state in Azure Table Storage.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Initializes the Azure Table via AzureTableDataManager.

methods.description: Lifecycle initialization callback that creates or ensures the Azure table exists.
